brief: 5 no-code tools that run an entire SaaS without an engineer on staff.

slots.desc1: Build complex web apps with visual logic and databases.
slots.desc2: Launch pixel-perfect marketing sites that convert visitors.
slots.desc3: Manage data, ops, and content in collaborative tables.
slots.desc4: Collect payments and manage subscriptions globally.
slots.desc5: Connect apps and automate tasks across your stack.

slots.toolTagline: The full-stack visual builder for real software startups.
slots.bigStatement: Ship production-grade web apps with databases, logic, and UX without code.
slots.use1Body: Build sign-up, log-in, and permission rules visually in minutes.
slots.use2Body: Create data-rich admin panels and user portals dynamically.
slots.use3Body: Trigger background jobs and connect to third-party services.

slots.toolTagline: Design responsive marketing sites with CMS power baked in.
slots.bigStatement: Own your brand story with pixel-perfect pages that load fast and convert.
slots.use1Body: Launch campaign pages with native A/B testing built right in.
slots.use2Body: Publish SEO-rich content without touching a single tag.
slots.use3Body: Gate content and manage user access through native logic.

slots.toolTagline: A relational database that feels like a spreadsheet but scales.
slots.bigStatement: Run your entire backend ops, content, and CRM from one collaborative source of truth.
slots.use1Body: Link records, attach assets, and filter views for every team.
slots.use2Body: Track leads, trials, and feedback in customizable pipelines.
slots.use3Body: Manage copy, images, and metadata for your app and site.

slots.toolTagline: The payments infrastructure that handles billing without engineering.
slots.bigStatement: Collect recurring revenue globally with subscriptions, invoices, and tax on autopilot.
slots.use1Body: Launch tiered plans, trials, and prorations in minutes.
slots.use2Body: Send branded invoices and accept wire or card payments.
slots.use3Body: Track MRR, churn, and LTV through a clean dashboard.

slots.toolTagline: Visual automation that moves data between apps while you sleep.
slots.bigStatement: Replace manual work with scenario-driven workflows that sync your stack 24/7.
slots.use1Body: Enroll new signups into welcome sequences and CRM records.
slots.use2Body: Keep Airtable, Bubble, and Stripe records in perfect harmony.
slots.use3Body: Pipe support tickets and errors to Slack and email instantly.

slots.toolTagline: One inbox for chat, email, and support without a helpdesk bill.
slots.bigStatement: Delight customers with unified messaging, bots, and knowledge base out of the box.
slots.use1Body: Talk to website visitors and app users in real time.
slots.use2Body: Deflect common questions with automated no-code bot journeys.
slots.use3Body: Route emails, social DMs, and SMS to one team view.

slots.body: This six-tool stack replaces a full engineering team. Start building today and launch your revenue-generating SaaS this weekend.
